editorial.blurb: A beloved classic diner where crispy bacon, perfectly cooked skillets, and genuine hospitality make every visit feel like coming home.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the counter to watch the griddle action up close and experience the full nostalgic charm—the waitstaff knows regulars well and the coffee is exceptional.
